subject: Highlight same element in multiple plots on click/hover?

messages.author: c2a4124666613378
messages.subject: Highlight same element in multiple plots on click/hover?
parts:
Does anyone know if it's possible to link multiple plots (or tables) so that when an element is hovered over or clicked in one plot, it is highlighted there and in all of the other plots?

For example, it might be nice to have a line plot, scatter plot, and data table which are all linked so that hovering over an element (-> a row) in any of the plots highlights the element in all of the plots?

Here is an example along these lines in d3: http://bl.ocks.org/dukevis/6768900

Any ideas?
Keith
